notes.title: Coding Learn critical bug fixes
notes.notes:
Corrected:
[list]
[*] Description in the task condition at the first level associated with Console.WriteLine();
[*] Error in tests and task description with GlassCount
[*] Possible cause of graphical artifacts on amd video cards
[*] Possible reason for the impossibility to start the game on windows in some cases
[/list]

P.S. Please let us know if you experience crashes after this update.

notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42436661/8676160524b647b2e44845cec22b176c46bc4a12.png[/img]Hello! We fixed the following errors and bugs:
[olist]
[*] Fixed a bug with displaying the line number in which an error occurred, now it is displayed correctly.
[*] Fixed a bug with the localization of comments in the code, now English comments are given in the English version of the game.
[*] Fixed a bug with the button text, now the text in them is in the language selected in the game.
[*] The 5th task on the 1st level has been fixed; due to problems with tests, it considered even correct tasks to be incorrect.
[*] The Computer.WriteLine() command has been replaced by Console.WriteLine(); so that there are no discrepancies in contrast to the game from real tasks.
[*] Typos in a number of tasks have been fixed.
[*] fixing errors in tooltips on the first and third levels
[/olist]

However, at the moment we are actively trying to fix the following bugs and shortcomings:
[list]
[*] When choosing a graphics level, you may need to re-enter the game through the task manager.
[*] The interface does not display correctly in ultrawide resolution and we recommend using either a higher or lower screen resolution. It is guaranteed that the entire interface is displayed correctly if the resolution is 16:9.
[/list]
